engine.chooseProduct: Choose what the customer is taking

engine.paymentNote: Payment records the sale and confirms the booking — it does <1>not</1> start any operational timer.

toast.trackIt: Track it in the booking or Operations.

engine.draftNotReleased: The draft could not be released — reload and try again.

shopdrop.title: Shop & Drop
shopdrop.subtitle: Bag storage & retrieval — the primary MVP workflow
shopdrop.scanToStore: Scan each bag and the compartment to store them
shopdrop.oneBarcode: One unique barcode per physical bag
shopdrop.reservationNote: Post-payment, an AssetReservation locks one physical unit so no other booking can take it.
shopdrop.couriersCanSee: Couriers at this site can see it now.
shopdrop.wantBagsBrought: Want the bags brought to them?
shopdrop.askNow: Ask now while they are here — arranging it later means verifying them over the phone first.
shopdrop.heldNotReleased: The held compartment could not be released — reload and try again.
shopdrop.bookingConfirmed: Booking confirmed — timer NOT started yet.
shopdrop.bagsIntro: Enter each bag's type, size and weight so the system can suggest the best-fit compartment. Each bag gets one unique barcode; multiple bags may share one compartment.

operations.title: Active operations
operations.subtitle: Live sessions across all engines at this station

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.subtitle: All transactions at this station
bookings.emptyMessage: Bookings appear here as they are created.

bookingDetail.noActions: No actions available in this state.
bookingDetail.timerNotStarted: Timer not started — awaiting a fulfilment action (never payment).
bookingDetail.manualBarcode: Manual barcode (scan out / test wrong-bag rejection)
bookingDetail.verifyRequired: Retrieval is locked until the customer's identity is verified.
bookingDetail.stillRefundable: {{amount}} of this booking is still refundable.
bookingDetail.refundAmountHint: Defaults to everything the customer paid. Lower it for a partial refund.
bookingDetail.refundReasonHint: This is recorded against the booking and in the tenant audit trail.
bookingDetail.refundNote: The money goes back the way it came in — cash leaves the till, a card refund follows the same scheme — and the accountant sees it as a refund in the VAT return.
bookingDetail.refundOnly: Only {{amount}} is left to refund on this booking.
bookingDetail.refundRecordedDetail: {{amount}} returned in total on {{ref}}. It is on the booking and in the audit trail.
bookingDetail.reassignHint: Requires a reason — logged to the audit trail
